name: s247-room1-open
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, ladders: 6, bridges: 5, inside: 1, figX: 0, figY: 90, things: [] }); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); for (const d of bgShown.node.querySelectorAll(".portal[data-door] [data-leaf]")) { for (const p of d.querySelectorAll("path")) p.setAttribute("d", d.getAttribute("data-open")); for (const n of d.querySelectorAll("line, ellipse")) n.style.opacity = "0"; }
